briefdescription.para: Apply a set of heuristics to a new candidate.

detaileddescription.para: Heuristics are currently hierarchical. This may be more efficient than a graduated cost model because we don't need to evaluate all aspects of the model for each node in the queue. But it's really done to make the heuristics easier to debug and statistically analyze.

parameterdescription.para: provides the policy and current best candidate.
refers to the next SUnit candidate, otherwise uninitialized.
describes the scheduled zone that we are extending, or nullptr if Cand is from a different zone than TryCand.

simplesect.para: true if TryCand is better than Cand (Reason is NOT NoCand)

briefdescription.para: A MachineSchedStrategy implementation for PowerPC pre RA scheduling.
